name: roll20-party-tools-tests
description: Test harness and release tooling for the Party Tools browser extension. The extension itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies — this package exists so the tests can use jsdom and so a release can be packaged and validated reproducibly.

scripts.test: node test/sheets.test.js && node test/storage-init.test.js && node test/panel-ui.test.js
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
